title: CDC - Preventing Chronic Disease: Content Syndication
content: Content Syndication Print Minus Related Pages Would you like to share PCD articles with your colleagues and/or students by posting them directly on your Web site? PCD readers can now use the free and easy content syndication tool to display CDC content on their own Web sites. Spread the knowledge without sending visitors away from your Web site. Look for the “syndicate this content” link on PCD articles you enjoy and visit https://www.cdc.gov/syndication for additional information and access to the self-registration process. The opinions expressed by authors contributing to this journal do not necessarily reflect the opinions of the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, the Public Health Service, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, or the authors’ affiliated institutions. Last Reviewed: April 2, 2015 Source: National Center for Chronic Disease Prevention and Health Promotion
